chunks: ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad al-Qāsānī, from Manṣūr ibn ʿAbbās and Aḥmad ibn Zakariyyā, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī ibn ʿĪsā, who said:

I asked Abā al-Ḥasan al-Awwal عليه السلام about a dry palm-frond, when he cuts it with his hand: is it permissible for the deceased that it be placed with him in his grave? He said: "The dry one is not permissible."

key_terms.السَّعَفَةِ: a palm-frond used here in the context of burial practice
key_terms.الْيَابِسَةِ: dry; describing the palm-frond as no longer fresh
key_terms.تُوضَعُ: to be placed or set down
key_terms.لَا يَجُوزُ: it is not permissible; a clear legal ruling

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to place a dry palm-frond in the grave with the deceased according to Imam al-Kāẓim عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith records a legal question addressed to Abā al-Ḥasan al-Awwal عليه السلام regarding placing a dry palm-frond in the grave with the deceased. The Imam عليه السلام rules that the dry one is not permissible, indicating a specific funerary ruling connected to burial practice.
